model: Fixed y=0.6 empirical fast-ion stopping increment expression

provenance.method: Frozen independent-engine binary64 observations; representation-only projection.
provenance.transformation: Only port names change. Exact input bits, original expected component strings, F-order shapes, case order and rules remain unchanged.
provenance.unit_metadata_correction: Local volumetric deposition power density is W/m^3, not total injected W. No input values or formula changed.
provenance.ceiling: Specified-expression source-behavior evidence, not physical calibration, pitch-geometry equivalence or application validation.

rules.finite_rule: abs(candidate-source) <= finite_atol + finite_rtol*abs(source), separately for real and imaginary components
exact: all source denominator rows have fixtures
rules.signed_zero: Recorded explicitly; numerically equal zeros accepted irrespective of sign because D1 is not bitwise equality.
rules.failures: Shape incompatibility must fail in both engines; wording/engine identifiers are retained but not required identical.
rules.warnings: Retain diagnostics; warning text equivalence is not a D1 numerical criterion.
rules.gate: Any mismatch fails the selected run; do not tune thresholds or remove cases.
